title: A question waiting on you never stops a session from orchestrating
why: Your idea, Oct 26 (waiting page, item 30): "have questions time out and/or expire so that way they dont hang for a long time ... it realizes owner wont answer atm and it gets back to orchestrating".
note: Design (c77 thread and triage, Oct 26): a literal timer breaks rule outcomes-mechanize-rules (no timer, no long-lived process), and a hook cannot cancel a question already on screen. So the shape: while a session has agents or lanes running, it never opens a blocking question box; it puts the question on the waiting page (c71) and in its reply, keeps working on what does not depend on the answer (rule questions-go-to-owner), and reads the answer at its next turn. With nothing running, the box stays, linking the page (ruling 3a, c71). Your idea asks for that narrowing of 3a, so it needs no further answer. Built (PR 648, merged Oct 27): amends questions-go-to-owner, the waiting-page skill and its decision (ruling 3b, narrows 3a). No check: the question hook judges the box alone and cannot see live agents, so a check does not fit it; debt question-box-while-work-runs records the gap. Separate from c77: PR 642 fixes the disk-fill cause by itself. Port: yes, the rule is global. Placed after c77, ahead of c75 (triage, Oct 26): a hanging question stalls every lane behind it.
